company.name: WANTD
company.shortDescription: WANTD is a consumer marketplace for fashion and footwear brands to launch and sell products.
company.description: WANTD is the first sneaker marketplace built specifically for power resellers, who hold 80% of the secondary sneaker market supply.  These power sellers are looking for ways to bulk manage their inventory while preserving their brand identity online, helping them move inventory quickly and efficiently.  WANTD provides a platform for live video auctions, virtual storefronts, and bulk listing tools so that these resellers can move inventory in minutes, not weeks.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $920,000, or 53.49% of reported total funding.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,276,970 to $11,859,471, a 5.21x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
